app.name: Assistant Cabinet AI
app.subtitle: Administrative assistance, on the practice network

status.label: Server
status.degraded: Connected, but no model is available

chat.emptyBody: What you write stays on the practice network. Nothing is sent outside it.
chat.keyboardHint: Enter sends. Shift and Enter start a new line.
chat.disclaimer: Administrative assistance. Always check the answer: the practitioner remains the sole decision maker. Nothing is sent automatically.

workFolder.title: Work folder
workFolder.description: The only folder this software may write into. Choose a dedicated subfolder, not the whole of your documents.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageDescription: The interface, the messages and the language the answers are written in.
settings.serverUrlDescription: The practice server. Never a public service.
settings.modelAliasDescription: Which profile answers. The list comes from the server.
settings.modelAliasUnavailable: The server has not listed its profiles yet.

errors.context_too_large: This question is too long for one request ({chars} characters for a limit of {limit}). Shorten it.
errors.internal_error: The server ran into an unexpected problem. Try again; if it persists, note the time and report it.
errors.invalid_request: The server refused the request because it was malformed. Please report it.
errors.model_alias_not_allowed: The profile {requested} is not offered by this server. Choose another one in the settings.
errors.output_locale_not_supported: This software cannot yet answer in the language {requested}.
errors.provider_capability_unsupported: The server cannot do this yet ({capability}).
errors.provider_error: The model did not answer correctly. Try again.
errors.provider_unreachable: The server is running but its model is not answering. Warn whoever looks after the machine.
errors.server_error: The server replied with an error (code {status}).
errors.server_response_invalid: The server reply could not be read.
errors.server_timeout: The server took too long to answer. Try again.
errors.server_unreachable: No answer from the server at {url}. Check that the machine is on and on the same network.
errors.server_url_invalid: This server address cannot be used ({url}). It must start with http:// or https://.
errors.settings_read_failed: Your settings could not be read, so the default ones are in use.
errors.settings_write_failed: Your settings could not be saved.
errors.work_folder_is_drive_root: A whole disk cannot be the work folder ({path}). Choose a folder inside it.
errors.work_folder_is_protected: This folder is protected, or it holds all of your personal files ({path}). Choose a dedicated subfolder.
errors.work_folder_is_symlink: This folder is a shortcut to somewhere else ({path}). Choose the real folder.
errors.work_folder_not_a_directory: This is a file, not a folder ({path}).
errors.work_folder_not_writable: This software cannot write into this folder ({path}).
errors.work_folder_unc_not_supported: A network folder cannot be the work folder yet ({path}).
